name: spindle
title: Spindle: disc and shaft
orientation: The disc on the bed, the shaft up, as it goes on
description: The output's flange turns the spindle; the spindle's shaft runs in the 6800 and carries the thigh on a hexagon at its top.

disc.rule: Thick enough for a countersunk M3

head.rule: A countersunk head, flush with the disc so the bridge passes over

shaft.rule: A close slide into the bearing's bore, clamped end to end by the thigh's screw

collar_top.rule: Where the inner race rests, above the disc's underside

shoulder.rule: Stops the inner race; clears the outer race

hex.rule: Hexagon across its flats: inside the bore, drives the thigh

cos30.rule: A hexagon, across corners to across flats
